import urllib.request, json
url='https://rest.ensembl.org/sequence/id/ENSDART00000149395?type=cdna&content-type=text/plain'
req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Content-Type':'text/plain'})
s=urllib.request.urlopen(req).read().decode()
print(len(s), s[:80], s[-80:])
# promoter
url2='https://rest.ensembl.org/sequence/region/danio_rerio/7:40883512..40884112:1?content-type=text/plain'
req2=urllib.request.Request(url2, headers={'Content-Type':'text/plain'})

print(len(p), p[:80], p[-80:])
# expected TSS at p[500], transcript start base should match p[500]
print('TSS char p[500]=', p[500], 'trans first=', s[0])
print('next 20 p', p[500:520])
print('next 20 transcript', s[:20])
PY"
